The "past 90d" block now shows the main LOC of the repositories with commits in the past 90 days. It was printing `loc180Days` in the LOC text, while the percentage already used `loc90Days`.

The fix is a one-word change in `addBigRepositoriesSummary` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportOverviewSection.java`. In your example, the "past 90d" block should now say 500 LOC and the "past 180d" block 2.5K LOC.

I only checked that the `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or add one for this block.
